description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class, specifically testing its handleSystemNotify method to validate notification handling logic, authorization, input validation, and error handling.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: Contains test cases for verifying the behavior of SystemHandler's notify handling logic.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: A mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster used for testing, simulating posting notifications.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: A mock implementation that throws exceptions on post to simulate error scenarios during notification posting.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Test that SystemHandler rejects notifications from unauthorized posters.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsEmptyNotification
methods.description: Test that SystemHandler rejects notifications with empty or whitespace-only title/body.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Test that SystemHandler rejects invalid JSON request objects.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Test that a valid notification is successfully posted.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_trimsAndPassesOptionalFields
methods.description: Test that optional fields are trimmed and passed correctly.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnauthorizedWhenPostFailsPermission
methods.description: Test that permission errors result in NOT_AUTHORIZED response.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnavailableWhenPostFailsUnexpectedly
methods.description: Test that unexpected errors during posting result in UNAVAILABLE response with error message.
